title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta4

## Persistent LiDAR terrain overlay backend

This prerelease turns the H2 LiDAR terrain resource discovered with the explicit development probe into a normal runtime capability for the standalone Map Card. The runtime path is completely independent from `navimower_diagnostics/probes`.

### Versioned vendor terrain cache

- Add an independent `TerrainOverlayManager` that checks `/mowerbot/vehicle/common/get-iot-file` with `type=2` outside the normal fast private-cloud polling path.
- Use the vendor file `version` as the cache key. A cached terrain package is checked at a bounded 15-minute cadence and the ~2 MB archive is downloaded only when that version changes.
- When no supported terrain resource has ever been cached, retry at a conservative 6-hour cadence so non-LiDAR models do not create regular cloud traffic.
- Keep signed vendor download URLs backend-only and in memory for the duration of a download; they are never placed in Map API payloads, diagnostics or persistent cache files.
- Validate the type-2 package as a bounded ZIP, parse its terrain metadata JSON, validate local XY extents and WebP signatures, and reject oversized archives before replacing the last-good cache.
- Persist only normalized metadata plus the extracted terrain/elevation WebP files under Home Assistant `.storage/navimower_terrain/<entry_id>/`, using atomic replacements and retaining the last-good cache across cloud failures or Home Assistant restarts.
- Remove the per-entry terrain cache when the Navimower config entry is removed.

### Map Card API contract

- Advertise a separate `frontend.terrain_overlay` capability instead of pretending LiDAR is another mutually exclusive base-map provider.
- Expose the vendor-local XY extent and relevant terrain metadata (`pixel_per_meter`, `grid_map_size_m`, elevation maximum and resource version) for direct alignment with existing mower-local map geometry.
- Add authenticated image endpoints at `/api/navimower/terrain/{entry_id}/terrain` and `/api/navimower/terrain/{entry_id}/elevation`.
- Site/Multi-mower metadata inherits the same per-mower terrain capability through the existing frontend metadata contract.
- Capability is resource-driven: no H2 model ID is hard-coded, so future models exposing the same valid type-2 package can use the same path automatically.

### Verified package format

The decoder is regression-tested against the observed vendor package layout (`merge2d*.webp`, `adapt*.webp` and the accompanying JSON metadata) and was also validated against the captured H2 type-2 package used during the 0.4.5-beta2 terrain investigation.

This release provides the integration/backend half only. A companion Map Card beta will add the selectable LiDAR overlay above OSM/orthophoto/Google and below Navimow zones, trails and mower graphics.
